interfaces.name: Probe.CurvatureTensor
interfaces.purpose: explicit compilable interface for the Riemann curvature tensor missing from pinned mathlib
fields: toFun : (x : M) -> TangentSpace I x ->L[R] TangentSpace I x ->L[R] TangentSpace I x ->L[R] TangentSpace I x
antisymm : forall x X Y Z, toFun x X Y Z = - toFun x Y X Z
bianchi : forall x X Y Z, toFun x X Y Z + toFun x Y Z X + toFun x Z X Y = 0

interfaces.name: Probe.CurvatureTensor.zero
interfaces.purpose: identically zero curvature tensor inhabiting the interface

interfaces.name: Probe.CurvatureTensor.endo
interfaces.purpose: the endomorphism X -> R(X,Y)Z used for the Ricci contraction

interfaces.name: Probe.CurvatureTensor.ricci
interfaces.purpose: Ricci contraction Ric(Y,Z) = trace(X -> R(X,Y)Z) built with LinearMap.trace

blockers.description: Pinned mathlib has no Riemann curvature tensor
blockers.evidence: grep -ri curvature Mathlib finds only a comment in MeasureTheory/Measure/Doubling.lean; #check_failure RiemannCurvatureTensor and #check_failure RiemannianCurvature report Unknown identifier
blockers.impact: curvature-based evolution equations cannot use a mathlib object
blockers.mitigation: Probe.CurvatureTensor interface in Probe/GeometryApi.lean with checked toy theorems

blockers.description: Pinned mathlib has no Ricci tensor or scalar curvature
blockers.evidence: #check_failure RicciTensor reports Unknown identifier; no ricci/scalar curvature matches in Mathlib
blockers.impact: Ricci flow equation must be stated through an explicit Ricci interface
blockers.mitigation: Probe.CurvatureTensor.ricci defined by LinearMap.trace; ricci_add_toy and ricci_zero_toy checked
